“Jade Plastic Box” most likely refers to **“Plastic Box,” a 2025 song by the English singer JADE**. It was released on 20 June 2025 as a single from her debut solo studio album *That’s Showbiz Baby*, and sources describe it as an electronic synth-pop track about insecurity over a partner’s past relationships.[4][6]

## What it is

The strongest match is the song **“Plastic Box” by JADE**, not a literal storage box. One source identifies it as a single by JADE released through RCA Records on 20 June 2025, while another music source lists the same release date and credits Jade Thirlwall, Lauren Aquilina, GRADES, and Oscar Görres among the writers and producers.[6][4]

## Related items

There are also merchandise results connected to JADE’s official shop, including a **“Plastic Box” keyring charm** described as a dual-charm keyring with a jade-themed plastic box, plus a **blue “Plastic Box” T-shirt** featuring a white print on jade blue fabric. These appear to be merch tie-ins rather than the main meaning of the phrase.[1][2]

## Where to find it

The track appears on Spotify as both a song entry and a single release page, and there is also a YouTube upload carrying the official audio metadata. The official music video is also reported to have premiered on 20 June 2025.[5][8][4][6]
